findings.description: Revision 4 fully resolves all round-2 correctness blockers by specifying pre-SENSE lifecycle maintenance, Git-commit derived staleness reference timestamps, exact timestamp matching between manifest as_of and scored_at, and complete cache-only re-rank time semantics for state_updated_at versus generated_at.
findings.resolution: The spec scenarios and design decisions accurately cover all lifecycle state transitions, timestamp validation rules, and store capacity bounds without ambiguity.

findings.description: The separation of responsibilities between digest.py (store, prepare-batch, rank, digest, stub-to-request, decide) and cycle_state.py state helpers maintains the host-assisted invariant while avoiding monolithic script bloat.
findings.resolution: Architecture maintains clean module boundaries and isolates model scoring to host sub-agent dispatches without introducing network or SDK calls into scripts.

findings.description: The atomic roll-forward transaction journal (.digest-transaction.json) with digest.json written last as the commit marker guarantees crash-recoverable publication and prevents mixed cache/digest states across failures.
findings.resolution: Scoring failures preserve prior valid digest artifacts and leave the successful cycle ledger fingerprint unadvanced, ensuring deterministic retry on subsequent cycles.

findings.description: The security posture is robust with strict 64 KiB complete canonical prompt manifest bounds, 2 KiB provenance excerpt caps, contained UTF-8 regular file validation, untrusted data delimiters, and string sanitization.
findings.resolution: Symlinks, URIs, binary files, and out-of-root paths are safely rejected before dispatch, failing closed to degraded markers without exposing host infrastructure.

findings.description: The digest.schema.json weights object comprehensively exposes all ranking policy constants, penalty caps, risk direction, decision and dependency bucket orders, and tie-breaking rules for total deterministic rank reconstructibility.
findings.resolution: Every factor score, justification, and mechanical signal is recorded per ranked stub, providing complete transparency into supervisor candidate prioritization.

findings.description: The refine-roadmap integration preserves explicit stub priorities while decoupling insertion positioning via --after, ensuring zero contract mismatch with existing roadmap tooling.
findings.resolution: The plan routes approvals through refiner.py preview and apply transactions with base SHA checks, avoiding direct roadmap file mutations or priority renumbering side effects.
